subject: ddl: make the check to InvolvingSchemaInfo mandatory (#64568)
summary: Makes `InvolvingSchemaInfo` validation mandatory for all DDL job submissions by adding `model.Job.CheckInvolvingSchemaInfo()` and invoking it in `ddl.executor.DoDDLJobWrapper` before enqueuing. Removes the previous test-only panic-based check and replaces it with an always-on error return that aligns with the scheduler’s “enumerate-type” assumptions for dependency calculation.
